head: e4fa6fd812c32bcc5cb6cfa8016448f2826a7ce4
preserved_probe_limitations: arena-probe-01: the compiler elided the unobserved 17 MiB allocation. The successor touches it through volatile accesses and requires a positive mmap counter; both raw probe outputs remain preserved.
limitations: Explicit heap limits now cover this allocator's actual System request, including its header and rounding, not System metadata or retained arena capacity.
Allocator observations are version-dependent and non-atomic; the all-arena comparison is established only for this pinned libc. Older runtimes may lack mallinfo2, which remains optional.
Allocator system bytes are not RSS. A live-thread probe retained about 166 MB of arenas after freeing almost all payloads; trimming released resident pages without removing most arena capacity.
The probe invokes malloc_trim only inside its isolated test process. Production allocation/retention policy is unchanged.
Other caller threads, driver-created stacks, cached thread storage, allocator fragmentation/retention, opaque/shared driver storage and phase overlaps still need enforced ownership bounds.
Ordinary workload admission remains closed for incomplete lifetime profiles.
Broader/live-cache workloads, five matched throughput pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64/deadline/depth/size gates, multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and newer Apple source integration remain open.
